decisions.reason: The sewer pipe cleaning box was launched only in 2024, and there is no evidence yet that it falls short of aspiration levels, so it is too early to start problemistic search. It fits the firm's municipal infrastructure niche and costs little to keep.
Public waste bins are a standard fabricated-metal product with steady municipal demand. With no reported shortfall after one year, management would carry the product while results remain uncertain.

Ground sleeves for posts overlap with the cast iron and steel variants, so there is some risk of consolidation. The general line is still likely kept as the umbrella offering in the street-furniture range.
Cast iron ground sleeves add a material variant at little extra cost. With no evidence of underperformance against aspirations, the firm has little reason to drop it so soon.
Steel ground sleeves are close to the firm's core metalworking capabilities and need few extra resources. Satisficing management would keep them absent clear negative feedback.
